<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914033_theRebbe_108" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914033_theRebbe_108__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The superior level of teshuvah must be performed with great joy, which breaks all boundaries and extends throughout the year in both spiritual and material matters, culminating in the ultimate expansion of the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is known what is written in Igeres HaTeshuvah,</t>
    <t s="2">that the superior level of teshuvah (teshuvah ila'ah) is with great joy.</t>
    <t s="3">And from this it is understood a fortiori regarding the teshuvah of Shabbos Teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="4">that in the superior teshuvah itself, it is an exceedingly lofty level,</t>
    <t s="5">to the point that even Havayah Ado-nai is considered like Elokim,</t>
    <t s="6">that it must be with great and intense joy.</t>
    <t s="7">And since joy breaks boundaries,</t>
    <t s="8">behold, through joy during the Ten Days of Repentance,</t>
    <t s="9">and especially on Shabbos Teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="10">they break all measures and limitations,</t>
    <t s="11">"Answer me with the expanse of Yah,"</t>
    <t s="12">and this is drawn down upon and throughout the entire year,</t>
    <t s="13">in spiritual matters,</t>
    <t s="14">that the service of Torah and mitzvos will be with expansiveness and in a manner of breaking through,</t>
    <t s="15">and also in physical matters—with ample children, life, and sustenance,</t>
    <t s="16">and up to the true expansiveness that will be with the coming of Mashiach Tzidkeinu,</t>
    <t s="17">"and it will be spacious... upward, in the future Yerushalayim will be expanded, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="18">"In the future Yerushalayim will spread throughout all Eretz Yisrael, and in the future Eretz Yisrael will spread throughout all lands,"</t>
    <t s="19">with the coming of Mashiach Tzidkeinu, very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The superior level of teshuvah must be performed with great joy, which breaks all boundaries and extends throughout the year in both spiritual and material matters, culminating in the ultimate expansion of the future redemption.

translations.translation: And it is known what is written in Igeres HaTeshuvah,
that the superior level of teshuvah (teshuvah ila'ah) is with great joy.
And from this it is understood a fortiori regarding the teshuvah of Shabbos Teshuvah,
that in the superior teshuvah itself, it is an exceedingly lofty level,
to the point that even Havayah Ado-nai is considered like Elokim,
that it must be with great and intense joy.
behold, through joy during the Ten Days of Repentance,
they break all measures and limitations,
"Answer me with the expanse of Yah,"
and this is drawn down upon and throughout the entire year,
that the service of Torah and mitzvos will be with expansiveness and in a manner of breaking through,
and also in physical matters—with ample children, life, and sustenance,
and up to the true expansiveness that will be with the coming of Mashiach Tzidkeinu,
"and it will be spacious... upward, in the future Yerushalayim will be expanded, etc.,"
"In the future Yerushalayim will spread throughout all Eretz Yisrael, and in the future Eretz Yisrael will spread throughout all lands,"
with the coming of Mashiach Tzidkeinu, very soon.
